verdict.rationale: LocalAI's own docs describe a distributed mode: GPU worker nodes self-register with a frontend coordinator and scale horizontally. That roughly matches spreading inference across multiple GPUs, closest to data parallelism. Nothing documents tensor or pipeline parallelism, or splitting one model across GPUs. missing for 10: explicit tensor-parallel support, pipeline-parallel support, multi-GPU model sharding configuration within a node, explicit documentation that horizontal scaling distributes inference load (data parallelism), hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can distribute inference across multiple GPUs using tensor, pipeline, or data parallelism

citations.quote: Distributed nodes: Add GPU worker nodes that self-register with a frontend coordinator
LocalAI supports distributed mode with horizontal scaling
